lede.en: Two cross-beams mount under the frame and carry the printed phone bed. The phone lies in the bed with the screen up, level under the stylus. Its top-left corner sits against the corner of the bed.
lede.zh: 两根横梁装在框架底面，承载 3D 打印的手机托架。手机屏幕朝上放入托架，水平置于触控笔下方。手机左上角抵住托架内角。

body.en: Build two identical cross-beams for the bed.
body.zh: 为托架装配两根相同横梁。

h3.en: Seat the bed on the beams

body.en: 1. Lay the two cross-beams parallel, slotted faces up. 2. Lower the hanging T-nuts of the bed into the slots. 3. Tighten the screws.
body.zh: 1. 把两根横梁平行摆放，开槽面朝上。2. 把托架的 T 型螺母放入槽内。3. 拧紧螺栓。

body.en: It is far easier with the frame upside down. 1. Turn the frame over, underside up. 2. Slide the T-nuts of each beam into the slots under the frame.
body.zh: 把框架翻转过来操作更方便。1. 把框架翻转过来，底面朝上。2. 把每根横梁的 T 型螺母滑入框架底面的型材槽。

body.en: Put a phone on the bed, against the top-left corner. Slide the X carriage over the whole screen. Make sure that the stylus tip reaches every part of the screen.
body.zh: 把手机放到托架上，抵住左上角。在整个屏幕范围内推动 X 滑座。确认触控笔尖能触及屏幕的每个位置。

body.en: Set the solenoid height so that the stylus tip just makes stable contact with the screen. If the solenoid is too low, it cannot pull in fully. The magnetic force is then too weak to hold the tip down. The tip springs back, so long presses and swipes fail. If the solenoid is too high, the tip cannot reach the screen, or the contact patch is too small.
body.zh: 调整电磁铁高度，使触控笔尖恰好稳定接触屏幕。电磁铁过低时无法完全吸合，吸力不足以压住笔尖。笔尖弹回，长按和滑动都会失败。电磁铁过高时，笔尖够不到屏幕，或接触面太小。

body.en: The rear camera bump lifts one corner, so the phone does not lie flat. Put a piece of thin card or a few sheets of paper under the low edge. Add more until the screen is level. Make sure that the phone cannot rock or shift when the stylus taps. Any tilt or wobble causes missed taps.
body.zh: 后置摄像头的凸起会顶起手机一角，手机无法放平。在较低的一边垫几张纸或一片薄卡纸。垫到屏幕水平为止。确认触控笔点击时手机不晃动、不移位。稍有倾斜或松动，点击就会失准。
